description: From the old harbor, a short mole and a small stone lighthouse sit in front of the Fortezza, whose low sloping bastions cover the whole hill above the tiled roofs. The sky is partly cloudy, about 75 percent cloud, about 19.5°C, with wind near 6 km/h. There is no rain. The light is soft morning daylight, and the walls are not floodlit.
